name: io.github.sepehr071/namasha-mcp
title: Namasha Videos
description: Read-only Namasha (namasha.com) Iranian video platform: search, videos, channels, categories.

environmentVariables.name: NAMASHA_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Namasha requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
